"Amen" — last word of Revelation 22:21 (exact capital-A only)

label: Jesus + GOD (uppercase titles) = 7,777
note: All-caps names of God (LORD, GOD, JEHOVAH, I AM, JAH) + all-caps Christ titles (BRANCH, KING) + Jesus/JESUS pure (980). I AM counts only Exodus 3:14's 3 occurrences — where God defines his own name.

label: Total Verses = 7,774 + 7,775 + 7,776 + 7,777 = 31,102
note: 31,102 is the unique four-consecutive-integer staircase ending on 7,777

label: Jesus(*) + Christ(*) = 777 + 777 = 1,554
note: Jesus(*) = Jesus + Jesus' + JESUS (all caps). Christ(*) = Christ + Christs + Christ's + Christian + Christians. 3 Jesus antimentions + 2 false-Christ antimentions excluded.

note: Capital-F Father (259 = 37×7) + capital-S Son (231 = 33×7). Possessives and antimentions excluded.
